name: 피오라
visual_review: 갈색 포니테일·리본·초록 눈·펜싱복을 유지했습니다. 각각의 찌르기 사이 팔 회수와 보폭 변화가 있으며 세 번째 찌르기에 가장 큰 흰푸른 검기가 붙습니다.
motion_summary: Fiora brown ponytail with blue ribbon, green eyes, white-and-blue fencing suit and thin rapier from portrait. Official Fleche R is THREE escalating forward thrusts. Animate ready fencing guard; drawing elbow back; first short lunge and narrow white-blue thrust; quick knee and rapier recoil; second deeper forward lunge with blue thrust streak; pull back to compact guard; torso coil for final; strongest long lunge with three sharp silver-blue pointed trails; brief tiny gold touche flash at blade point; retract arm; recover feet; original guard. Three distinct thrusts with actual elbow/body extension and visible recovery, never generic sword circles.
